name: Yuk Dae Jang
notes: 4 photos. 1.jpg is a sushi 'New Rolls'/'Other Sushi' menu board unrelated to this Korean soup restaurant (different cuisine, likely mistagged) and was excluded entirely. 2.jpg and 3.jpg show the same to-go/retail trifold (kimchi, frozen soup packs, mandu) but with conflicting prices between the two photos (e.g. whole cabbage kimchi $17 vs $15, frozen soups $85/$90 vs $80/$85); used 3.jpg's prices as the clearer, more complete shot and added its exclusive item (freeze-dried CY pepper), plus 2.jpg's exclusive item (pickled Korean plum). 4.jpg is the main dish board and is the source of most dishes. Toppings and Soda/Alcohol sections skipped as modifiers/drinks. One item (Yuk Kal Myun) had its price covered by a sticker so price was omitted; one item (Mul Naengmyeon) had a partly cut-off description so only name and price were kept.
